messages:
michael (docs): Quick sync — large docs refactor touching the migration guide and examples. Previews are throwing anchor/link errors. PRs involved: #4210 (move migration -> /guides/migrations/overview.md), #4214 (rename examples + redirect map), #4218 (SDK v2 snippets). Preview: https://deploy-preview-4210--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/migrations/overview.html#upgrade-step-3

rachel (eng): yeah I saw that. link-checker flags `#upgrade-step-3` as missing when the file moves before redirects exist. Do we want to land redirects first?

tom (platform): Recommended order: create a lightweight redirect PR that maps old path -> new path (temporary), merge it, then move files. I can also flip the docs link-checker to warn-only for a short window.

deploy-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4210 failed: 2 broken links detected -> /guides/migration.html#upgrade-step-3, /examples/sdk-helpers.html#old-helper

michael (docs): Proposed sequence: 1) tom opens redirect PR (#4220) with a single mapping in redirects.yml 2) merge #4220 -> confirm preview OK 3) merge #4210 (move) 4) merge #4214 (cleanup redirects + examples rename) 5) merge #4218 (snippet updates). Requesting reviews: @rachel and @jana for #4210. Preferred merge window: today 16:30-17:30 PT.

jana (docs): I'll review #4218 and handle the SDK snippet compatibility note. For user-facing examples I'll add a small alias for the renamed helper to avoid immediate breakage.

rachel (eng): I can review #4210 earlier. One local repro note: run `yarn docs:build` then `npm run link-check` to see the same failure. Error I saw:
```
LinkCheckerError: Missing anchor 'upgrade-step-3' in /guides/migration.md
```

tom (platform): Redirect PR #4220 created (WIP) — single entry: `/guides/migration.html -> /guides/migrations/overview.html`. I'll mark it as urgent. If we need, I'll set the link-checker job to WARN for 45 minutes around the window.

michael (docs): Add `docs/merge-window` label to all 4 PRs. After each merge run: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview https://deploy-preview-<PR>` and check anchors. If anything fails, rollback plan: revert the most recent merge (quick revert PR) and purge CDN cache for `/guides/*`.

rachel (eng): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby at 16:25 PT to approve #4210. If redirects don't propagate in preview, we may need to merge the temporary redirect twice (deploy race) or set link-checker warning as tom suggested.

tom (platform): Noted. I'll coordinate the warning flip and CDN purge. Also will add a short TTL on the redirect so it can be safely removed by #4214.

michael (docs): Thanks. I'll post a final checklist 10m before the window: (1) #4220 merged + preview green, (2) approvers on #4210 ready, (3) CI green, (4) tom has link-checker on warn. If anything blocks, call it out here.

jana (docs): One more item: examples rename might change permalinks for external blog posts. I'll add a short migration note to the top of /guides/migrations/overview.md linking to `docs/redirects` and our announcement.
